newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica Reserve Bank says didn't intervene on rand.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica Reserve Bank says didn't intervene on rand.

text.p: The South African Reserve Bank was engaged only in routine operations this morning and did not intervene in any noticeable way in the currency market, a central bank official said on Wednesday.
"The Reserve Bank has not been in the market in any noticeable way," he told Reuters. "The Bank has only been engaged in normal operations."
Some foreign exchange dealers had said they believed the Bank had supported the currency earlier in the day, helping it break through the 4.50 level on the dollar to a four-month high.
